title: First calibration doesn‘t work
symptom: After the calibration wizard was introduced, the first calibration in xDrip+ does not work: when the user measures a blood glucose of 90 mg/dl and enters it, xDrip+ shows LOW. Later attempts with a 2-hour warm-up still result in extreme low values (e.g., 50 mg/dl) after calibration, and a second calibration shows 89 mg/dl.
cause: jamorham suggests that with the G5 (and possibly G4) you cannot swap the transmitter to the sensor with such a short time; the G5 has internal electrical calibration, leading to messed up raw values. The transmitter should be connected for at least an hour, ideally the standard 2-hour warm-up.
fix: Try having the transmitter connected for at least an hour before attempting calibration, ideally the standard 2 hour warm up. Additionally, a workaround from Jane49: switch the phone off, do the swap, wait around 30 mins, then switch on again.
evidence_quote: Try having the transmitter connected for at least an hour before attempting calibration, ideally the standard 2 hour warm up.
